title: Eric Schmidt: Are We Ready for Superintelligence? | Podcast | In Good Company
description:
Eric Schmidt has watched the technology industry reinvent itself again and again, and he is convinced this wave is the biggest yet. The former CEO of Google, today one of the leading voices on AI, joins Nicolai Tangen for a conversation about agents, superintelligence and power. Where does this leave large companies? What happens to Europe? And what is Schmidt most worried about? Schmidt also speaks about failure, the myth of the founder, and why he can never switch off. Tune in!

In Good Company is hosted by Nicolai Tangen, CEO of Norges Bank Investment Management. New episode out every Wednesday.

The podcast In Good Company is part of Norges Bank Investment Management, a podcast about our investments. We are transparent about how the fund is invested. In this podcast, you get a deeper insight into the companies the fund is invested in.

Our CEO, Nicolai Tangen, has in-depth interviews with the leaders of some of the largest companies in the world. You will get insight into their leadership principles, the company’s strategy and how they are dealing with a large investor like us. You will also learn more about our role as an owner of the companies.

You can read more about the podcast on https://www.nbim.no/en/publications/podcast/
summary: Eric Schmidt argues that the current AI revolution is the largest technological transformation in history, driven by fundamental discoveries and massive scale in compute, which will make the world significantly more efficient and profitable regardless of individual preferences. He illustrates this potential through examples of AI amplifying human decision-making speed, solving previously unsolvable math problems, and enabling future breakthroughs in physics and energy.
